Contract ManageItemCRUDService::deleteItem(barcode: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode),
		found: Boolean = if obs.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		Item.allInstance()->includes(obs) = found and
		result = found
}
